subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) 21st February is (i) many people going to the Shaheed Minar (b) Everyone goes (ii) flowers at the foot of the Shaheed Minar (c) Shaheed Minar is (iii) covered with flowers. (d) The National flag is (iv) to observe the day at the Shaheed Minar. (e) We offer (v) kept half mast (vi) carrying wrealth of flowers. (vii) declared the International
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (vii) 21st February is declared the International Mother Language Day. (b) + (iv) Everyone goes to observe the day at the Shaheed Minar. (c) + (iii) Shahed Minar is covered with flowers. (d) + (v) The National flag is kept half mast. (e) + (ii) We offer flowers at the foot of the Shaheed Minar.
